mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase everolimus metabolism through CYP3A4 induction and alter immunosuppressive effects; propylthiouracil carries hepatotoxicity risk that may compound mTOR inhibitor-related hepatic effects.
action: Monitor liver function tests closely and everolimus levels; consider alternative thyroid agent (levothyroxine) if possible; adjust everolimus dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
